components.text: Back to page 2: have you ticked all three goals?

notes: Before you go, copy these four pairs off the board. Pick the task and measure it: hand it writing, editing and summarizing, and before you roll out a new way of working, log the time and the rework. Grade the data and use approved tools: personal data and trade secrets stay out of public tools, and only approved tools are used. This pair matters most. Check it and label it: check facts, figures and quotes before they go out, and declare AI content you publish. Keep records and report mistakes: keep your prompts and drafts, and if something goes wrong, report it at once.
